create_detection_dataset_from_yolo: create a DetectionDataset from YOLO formatted images, annotations, and data YAML file
create_detection_dataset_from_pascal_voc: create a DetectionDataset from PASCAL VOC formatted images and XML annotation files
create_detection_dataset_from_coco: create a DetectionDataset from COCO formatted images and JSON annotation file
split_detection_dataset: split a DetectionDataset into training and testing subsets with a given ratio
merge_detection_datasets: merge multiple DetectionDataset objects into a single unified dataset
export_detection_dataset_to_yolo: export a DetectionDataset to YOLO format with optional images and data YAML
export_detection_dataset_to_coco: export a DetectionDataset to COCO format with optional images and annotation JSON
export_detection_dataset_to_pascal_voc: export a DetectionDataset to PASCAL VOC format with optional images and XML annotations
create_classification_dataset_from_folde: create a ClassificationDataset from a multi-class folder structure
export_classification_dataset_to_folder: export a ClassificationDataset to a multi-class folder structure
